column1: # The contracts of a testnet deployment (script/DeployTestnet.s.sol): manifest key, source file, contract name.
# script/verify-testnet.sh source-verifies each on the explorer; ops/release/publish-ipfs.sh publishes each one's
# compiler artifact. Poseidon is not listed: circomlibjs generates its bytecode (no Solidity source), and
# CheckTestnet checks the deployed hasher against circomlib's Poseidon(1, 2).
